works.body:
The last drawing was so good that we would like to request it again.
We would like you to put the former young man you drew last time in the baton twirling club.
As you can see in the reference image, he is marching through the city, and we would like you to draw a scene in which he is very embarrassed.
We would like to see her legs, etc., so it would be great if she were wearing a mini-skirt like the one shown in the figure, with her legs raised and even her underskirt visible.
This is another maniacal request, but we would appreciate it very much.

https://i.imgur.com/ti1asuU.jpg

I am requesting this because your male drawing is very attractive.
I am sorry to say that this is a very limited situation, but I would like you to draw an adult male who, for some reason, is made into a woman by modern and realistic means, such as sex change surgery or plastic surgery, and forced to live as a middle school girl.

In other words, the illustration should be of a girl, but her body is masculine, as you have depicted, which makes her look uncomfortable from the outside.
I would like her to have an expression of frustration and embarrassment because she has been made to look and live like this without wanting to for some reason.
There are no restrictions on clothing.
She could be wearing a school uniform, or she could be in some kind of club where she is actually being treated by younger seniors, or she could be wearing a brush that would be easy to draw.

I would appreciate it if you could make them wear skirts to give the impression that they are living as girls.
